description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Harried Spearguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Harried Spearguard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Harried Spearguard trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Harried Spearguard from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
